body.name: AI agents may not access PII
body.description: AI agents must not be able to reach any resource tagged pii, directly or through role inheritance.
body.source:
id: ai-agents-no-pii
name: AI agents may not access PII
type: forbidden_access
severity: critical
description: >
  AI agents must not be able to reach any resource tagged pii, directly or
  through role inheritance.
subjects:
  identity_types: [ai_agent]
resources:
  tags_any: [pii]

body.name: Leavers retain no access
body.description: Terminated identities must not have any effective permission in any system.
body.source:
id: terminated-access
name: Leavers retain no access
type: terminated_with_access
severity: critical
description: Terminated identities must not have any effective permission in any system.

body.name: Every NHI and AI agent has an active owner
body.description: Service accounts, API keys and AI agents must have an owner who is a current employee.
body.source:
id: nhi-ownership
name: Every NHI and AI agent has an active owner
type: nhi_ownership
severity: high
description: Service accounts, API keys and AI agents must have an owner who is a current employee.

body.name: Non-human identities may not hold prod admin
body.description: Service accounts and agents should use narrowly scoped roles, never admin on prod.
body.source:
id: nhi-no-prod-admin
name: Non-human identities may not hold prod admin
type: no_standing_access
severity: high
description: Service accounts and agents should use narrowly scoped roles, never admin on prod.
subjects:
  identity_types: [service, ai_agent]
match:
  privileged: true
  environment: prod

body.name: No standing admin on prod
body.description: Privileged permissions on production resources must be obtained just-in-time. Access reached only through a JIT grant does not violate this policy.
body.source:
id: no-standing-prod-admin
name: No standing admin on prod
type: no_standing_access
severity: high
description: >
  Privileged permissions on production resources must be obtained just-in-time.
  Access reached only through a JIT grant does not violate this policy.
subjects:
  identity_types: [human]
match:
  privileged: true
  environment: prod

body.name: SoD: create vs approve supplier payments
body.description: Nobody may hold both payments:create and payments:approve, regardless of which groups, roles or systems grant them.
body.source:
id: sod-payments
name: "SoD: create vs approve supplier payments"
type: separation_of_duties
severity: high
description: >
  Nobody may hold both payments:create and payments:approve, regardless of
  which groups, roles or systems grant them.
subjects:
  identity_types: [human, service, ai_agent]
conflict:
  a: ["payments:create"]
  b: ["payments:approve"]

body.name: Secrets rotated at least every 90 days
body.description: API keys, tokens and service credentials must be rotated within 90 days.
body.source:
id: stale-secrets
name: Secrets rotated at least every 90 days
type: secret_max_age
severity: medium
description: API keys, tokens and service credentials must be rotated within 90 days.
max_age_days: 90
